name: Items (general)
author: Molfar
description: Distinctive relics, tools, gadgets, curios and keepsakes with a story hook.

entries.name: Compass of Second Thoughts
entries.desc: A brass compass whose needle points to whatever the holder will regret leaving behind.

entries.name: Teacup of Honest Steam
entries.desc: A chipped porcelain cup that releases steam shaped like the truth when filled with tea.

entries.name: Spindle of Borrowed Hours
entries.desc: A wooden spindle that spins thread from lost time. Each skein buys the wearer a short extension of the day.

entries.name: Gloamglass Lens
entries.desc: A monocle that shows what a room looked like an hour earlier. Wearing it too long dims the eye.

entries.name: Lantern of Small Mercies
entries.desc: A tin lantern that lights only for travelers who are lost and not by choice.

entries.name: The Patient Key
entries.desc: A bronze key that opens any door, but only after being asked three times.

entries.name: Thimble of the Seventh Stitch
entries.desc: A silver thimble that lets its wearer sew a wound closed with ordinary thread.

entries.name: Bell That Rings Once
entries.desc: A hand bell that sounds a single time in a lifetime, for whatever matters most to the holder.

entries.name: Moth-Wing Cloak
entries.desc: A pale cloak that makes the wearer easy to overlook in lamplight and impossible to overlook in the dark.

entries.name: Cartographer's Ink
entries.desc: A bottle of ink that draws maps of places the writer is about to arrive at.

entries.name: Quill of Last Words
entries.desc: A feather pen that writes a person's final letter correctly, whether or not they know it will be the last.

entries.name: Tankard of Plenty-ish
entries.desc: A battered mug that fills with something drinkable, if rarely the drink you wanted.

entries.name: Brass Bee
entries.desc: A mechanical bee that carries messages between hives and, sometimes, between worlds.

entries.name: The Unspilled Cup
entries.desc: A goblet whose contents never spill, even if dropped. Its previous owner is unknown and apparently thirsty.

entries.name: Fogbound Compass
entries.desc: A strange compass that points to the next place the fog will lift.

entries.name: Loom of Quiet Hours
entries.desc: A small tabletop loom that weaves silence into a shawl, muffling every sound beneath it.

entries.name: Ring of Gentle Hands
entries.desc: A plain ring that prevents the wearer from striking in anger, to their frequent irritation.

entries.name: Boots of the Long Way
entries.desc: Worn boots that always find the scenic route, whether you want it or not.

entries.name: Bottled Dawn
entries.desc: A glass flask holding a single sunrise. Uncork it in a dark place and the light lasts a minute.

entries.name: Candle of Remembered Faces
entries.desc: A candle that shows the face of the last person who thought of you.

entries.name: Rune-Stitched Satchel
entries.desc: A leather bag with more inside than outside, and a talent for hiding the item you need.

entries.name: Pocket Orchard
entries.desc: A small pouch holding a living apple tree that bears one fruit a day, each a different taste.

entries.name: Amber Hourglass
entries.desc: An hourglass filled with resin that slows time around whoever turns it.

entries.name: Staff of the Third Branch
entries.desc: A walking staff that grows leaves when the wielder tells a lie.

entries.name: Nesting Dolls of the Wren Court
entries.desc: A set of wooden dolls that each hold a smaller secret than the last.

entries.name: Salt-Crowned Mask
entries.desc: A mask of dried salt that grants the wearer a sea-sailor's luck and a sailor's thirst.

entries.name: The Whistling Stone
entries.desc: A smooth stone that whistles a tune when someone nearby is hiding something.

entries.name: Wax Seal of the Silent King
entries.desc: A signet that closes a letter so tightly only the intended reader may open it.

entries.name: Lace of Ninefold Veils
entries.desc: A shawl of fine lace that hides the wearer from a single named person.

entries.name: Hearthstone Pendant
entries.desc: A small warm stone worn at the neck that guides its wearer home, however long the road.

entries.name: Rosary of Hanging Beads
entries.desc: A rosary made of small knuckle bones. Every bead whispers the name of someone who prayed with it.

entries.name: The Hollow Crown
entries.desc: A rusted crown whose wearer hears the voices of every ruler who wore it before.

entries.name: Knife of Unfinished Business
entries.desc: A short blade that never rusts and cannot be sheathed until its owner finishes what they began.

entries.name: Veil of the Weeping Widow
entries.desc: A black veil that shows the wearer how each person near them will die.

entries.name: Cup of Sour Wine
entries.desc: A battered chalice whose wine tastes of the drinker's worst regret. Priests say it purifies.

entries.name: Mourner's Lantern
entries.desc: A lantern whose light is cold and blue. Those who walk by it grieve without knowing why.

entries.name: Bone Dice
entries.desc: Six carved dice that always roll the number of years the player has left to live.

entries.name: The Pale Ledger
entries.desc: A cracked ledger recording debts owed to the dead, in ink that smells of earth.

entries.name: Skinbound Prayer Book
entries.desc: A prayer book bound in a stranger's skin. It opens to the prayer the reader most needs and least wants.

entries.name: Tallow Hand
entries.desc: A hand of candle wax that burns with a flame only the dying can see.

entries.name: Gravedigger's Spade
entries.desc: A heavy spade that digs any grave in a single stroke. It will not bury anyone still breathing.

entries.name: Rook's Tithe Purse
entries.desc: A black purse that fills with coins each dusk, taking one memory in exchange for every coin.

entries.name: The Last Rites Kit
entries.desc: A leather case of oils and a bell, used by a priest who has lost count of the dead.

entries.name: Iron Collar of the Pious
entries.desc: A heavy collar that makes the wearer honest and in constant pain.

entries.name: Thorned Gauntlet
entries.desc: A glove of steel thorns that bleeds its owner to pay for its strength.

entries.name: Moonless Mirror
entries.desc: A tarnished mirror that shows the viewer without their shadow, and sometimes with someone else's.

entries.name: Hunger Loaf
entries.desc: A black loaf that feeds anyone but leaves the eater hungrier than before.

entries.name: Bell of the Drowned
entries.desc: A rusted ship's bell that rings, when struck, from beneath the water in the distance.

entries.name: Cinder Locket
entries.desc: A locket holding ashes that whisper requests to the one who wears it.

entries.name: Plague Mask of Sweet Herbs
entries.desc: A beaked mask stuffed with herbs, said to ward off sickness and the sight of the sick.

entries.name: Scarecrow's Heart
entries.desc: A knot of straw and twine that beats faintly when a lie is told within earshot.

entries.name: Gallows Rope
entries.desc: A frayed rope that tightens by itself around the guilty.

entries.name: Lantern of the Last Mile
entries.desc: A lantern carried by the condemned that burns brighter as dawn approaches.

entries.name: Witch's Cradle
entries.desc: A small wooden cradle that rocks itself near anyone with an unborn curse.

entries.name: The Rotted Scepter
entries.desc: A scepter of black wood that crumbles when its bearer speaks a true promise.

entries.name: Sallow Candle
entries.desc: A yellow candle that burns away fever from the room but not from the sick.

entries.name: Ossuary Key
entries.desc: A key made of a finger bone, opening any tomb and tarnishing the one who uses it.

entries.name: Hollow Saint Medal
entries.desc: A medal showing a saint with no face. Pilgrims swear it listens.

entries.name: Wretch's Coin
entries.desc: A coin that cannot be spent. It only seeks a new owner who needs it more.

entries.name: Mantle of Ash Wool
entries.desc: A gray mantle that makes the wearer immune to cold and to joy.

entries.name: Pocket Orrery
entries.desc: A palm-sized orrery that shows the exact current positions of every ship in range.

entries.name: Cold Sleep Locket
entries.desc: A locket containing a single frozen heartbeat, recorded the day its owner went into cryosleep.

entries.name: Quantum Coin
entries.desc: A coin that lands as tails when observed by its owner and heads for everyone else.

entries.name: Black Box Cookbook
entries.desc: A cookbook assembled from recipes recovered from shipwreck logs, each with a note from the cook.

entries.name: Salvage King's Wrench
entries.desc: A worn wrench said to fit every bolt in the galaxy. Its original owner left no name.

entries.name: The Quiet Radio
entries.desc: A shortwave radio that receives only transmissions from stations that stopped broadcasting long ago.

entries.name: Gravity Marbles
entries.desc: A set of glass marbles that each fall in a different direction.

entries.name: Neutrino Teacup
entries.desc: A teacup that cools tea instantly and delivers it as a faint blue glow.

entries.name: Stationmaster's Pocket Watch
entries.desc: A watch set to three different times, used for ancient schedules.

entries.name: Meridian Visor
entries.desc: A pair of glasses that show the terraforming history of any surface.

entries.name: The Backup Cat
entries.desc: A small robot pet that stores the owner's memories and will not stop purring.

entries.name: Vacuum Seed Pod
entries.desc: A seed capsule that sprouts in zero gravity into a sprawling, ornamental vine.

entries.name: Escape Pod Sketchbook
entries.desc: A sketchbook found in a sealed pod, filled with drawings of landscapes no one has found.

entries.name: Hyperlane Dowsing Rod
entries.desc: A metal rod that twitches near stable jump points and stays stubbornly still near dead ends.

entries.name: Dreamlink Headband
entries.desc: A band that records dreams. The recordings are said to include more than the wearer saw.

entries.name: Ration Brick of Many Flavors
entries.desc: A tough ration brick that changes flavor with the hunger of whoever eats it.

entries.name: The Lost Log
entries.desc: A ship log that rewrites itself each time it is opened, always with a new omitted detail.

entries.name: Pulsar Tuning Fork
entries.desc: A tuning fork that hums in time with the nearest neutron star.

entries.name: Shipwright's Slate
entries.desc: A scratched tablet containing the blueprints for a ship that nobody has been able to build.

entries.name: Starlight Jar
entries.desc: A jar of glittering dust said to be the last light from a dead star.

entries.name: Mirrored Helmet
entries.desc: A battered helmet whose visor shows the wearer's reflection a moment late.

entries.name: The Patient Drone
entries.desc: A small drone that will wait at any location for any length of time, then deliver its message to whoever is there.

entries.name: Redshift Ring
entries.desc: A ring that shifts color when the wearer is moving fast. The color is never the same twice.

entries.name: Biolume Lamp
entries.desc: A glass jar of glowing algae that dims when someone nearby is lying.

entries.name: Glass Needle
entries.desc: A fine needle that can sew a hull breach shut with a thread of molten glass.

entries.name: Compass of Home
entries.desc: A magnetic compass that points to the world its owner was born on, wherever that might be.

entries.name: Hollow Moon Violin
entries.desc: A violin carved from fossilized coral that plays sweeter in low gravity.

entries.name: Bucket of Fresh Air
entries.desc: A battered bucket holding a few liters of breathable atmosphere from a world that no longer exists.

entries.name: Time Lag Letter
entries.desc: A paper letter written to be opened in a year, with the postage already paid in advance.

entries.name: Zero-G Chess Set
entries.desc: A magnetic chess set with pieces that float and a board that spins slowly.

entries.name: Sticky Notes of Doom
entries.desc: A pad of yellow notes found in an office drawer. Each one lists a task that someone eventually does.

entries.name: Grandfather's Thermos
entries.desc: A dented steel thermos that keeps coffee hot for hours. It still smells faintly of a stranger's pipe.

entries.name: Lost and Found Umbrella
entries.desc: A black umbrella that always seems to belong to someone else, but always finds its way back.

entries.name: The Last Cassette
entries.desc: A cassette tape labeled in a stranger's handwriting. Nobody can say who recorded the voice or why.

entries.name: Handwritten Recipe Card
entries.desc: A stained index card that no one can quite reproduce, no matter how carefully they follow it.

entries.name: Bus Pass of Many Routes
entries.desc: A transit card that always seems to carry a few more rides than it should.

entries.name: Wallet with Two Photos
entries.desc: A scuffed leather wallet containing two photographs of the same stranger, years apart.

entries.name: Dial-Tone Phone
entries.desc: A rotary phone that connects to numbers nobody has listed. Sometimes someone answers.

entries.name: Pocket Notebook of Strangers
entries.desc: A notebook where the owner has logged every unusual person they have met, with annotations.

entries.name: Mixtape for a Rainy Day
entries.desc: A hand-labeled mixtape that always seems to end with the exact right song.

entries.name: Antique Typewriter
entries.desc: A heavy typewriter whose keys occasionally type words the writer never intended.

entries.name: The Spare Key
entries.desc: A key hidden under a flowerpot that opens a door the owner has never seen.

entries.name: Receipt from a Closed Shop
entries.desc: A crumpled receipt that lists items nobody remembers buying, from a store that closed years ago.

entries.name: Birthday Candle Collection
entries.desc: A shoebox of used candles, each labeled with a year and a wish.

entries.name: Library Book Overdue
entries.desc: A library book with a thirty-year late fee and a pressed flower marking page two hundred and four.

entries.name: Neighbor's Casserole Dish
entries.desc: A glass dish passed between neighbors for years, always returned with something new inside.

entries.name: Digital Photo Frame
entries.desc: A battered photo frame that cycles through images no one remembers uploading.

entries.name: The Last Voicemail
entries.desc: A phone message that keeps replaying at the wrong moment, in a voice the listener does not know.

entries.name: Train Ticket to Nowhere
entries.desc: A paper ticket with a destination that is not on any timetable.

entries.name: Wristwatch That Runs Slow
entries.desc: A watch that runs four minutes late every day, giving its wearer a curious advantage.

entries.name: Old Library Card
entries.desc: A card with a long borrowing history, signed by someone who shares a name with the current owner.

entries.name: Pocket Mirror from the Lost Property Office
entries.desc: A cheap mirror that sometimes shows the previous owner's face instead of yours.

entries.name: Mix Bowl of Many Hands
entries.desc: A battered ceramic bowl passed through four generations of cooks and still used for Sunday dough.

entries.name: Late Night Radio
entries.desc: A bedside radio that plays a show from a station nobody can trace.

entries.name: Pawn Ticket 4471
entries.desc: A pawn ticket for an item that was never retrieved. The shop no longer remembers the pledge.

entries.name: The Cracked Phone
entries.desc: A smartphone with a spiderweb screen and messages from a number that is no longer in service.

entries.name: Fold-Up Chessboard
entries.desc: A travel chess set whose pieces have been replaced with bottle caps and buttons over the years.

entries.name: Shared Umbrella Stand
entries.desc: A hallway stand where every guest leaves an umbrella and finds a different one later.

entries.name: Tin of Buttons
entries.desc: A biscuit tin of mismatched buttons, each tied to a family story.

entries.name: Subway Map with Extra Line
entries.desc: A transit map with a line drawn in pen, leading somewhere that does not exist.

entries.name: Ghostwire Jack
entries.desc: A cracked data jack that connects to a network no one admits exists.

entries.name: Chrome Rosary
entries.desc: A strand of metallic beads that counts the user's remaining battery cycles.

entries.name: The Patient Fixer's Toolkit
entries.desc: A battered case of specialized tools favored by fixers, with a hidden drawer for illegal parts.

entries.name: Neon Tattoo Ink
entries.desc: Ink that glows in shifting colors according to the wearer's heart rate.

entries.name: Burnout Stim Pack
entries.desc: A jury-rigged injector kit that gives a night of brilliance and a week of regret.

entries.name: Hollow Drive
entries.desc: A data drive with no visible contents, rumored to hold something a corporation will kill for.

entries.name: The Courier's Coat
entries.desc: A reinforced coat with hidden pockets, stained with rain and a faint scent of ozone.

entries.name: Memory Chip of the Dead
entries.desc: A chip holding a stranger's last memories, played back by anyone with the right socket.

entries.name: Static Umbrella
entries.desc: An umbrella that blocks rain and surveillance drones in equal measure.

entries.name: Shock Noodle Cup
entries.desc: A self-heating ramen cup that doubles as a mild taser. Popular with students.

entries.name: The Last Analog Watch
entries.desc: A wind-up watch beloved by those who distrust synchronized time.

entries.name: Glass Eye Camera
entries.desc: A prosthetic eye with a built-in recorder. Its previous owner left some footage unerased.

entries.name: Backalley Surgeon's Chair
entries.desc: A scarred chair with leather straps, a cracked lamp and an air of silent apology.

entries.name: Mirror Shades
entries.desc: A set of lenses that makes the wearer's face unrecognizable to any camera.

entries.name: The Bootleg Soul
entries.desc: A cheap digital copy of a famous musician's mind, sold in street markets with many glitches.

entries.name: Neural Lace Glove
entries.desc: A glove that translates hand gestures into code, favored by hackers and street magicians.

entries.name: Datashard Necklace
entries.desc: A necklace of chipped crystal that stores one secret per bead.

entries.name: Rain Slick Boots
entries.desc: Waterproof boots that grip any wet surface and leave no footprints.

entries.name: Noise Pill
entries.desc: A capsule that fills the user's skull with white noise for an hour, defeating mind-reading scans.

entries.name: Vending Machine Key
entries.desc: A magnetic key that opens any street vending machine, taking only one item per use.

entries.name: Wire Tongue
entries.desc: A small implant that lets the user taste digital signals as flavors.

entries.name: Holo Locket
entries.desc: A locket that projects a single memory, always a rainy city street, always at night.

entries.name: Rooftop Antenna Charm
entries.desc: A good luck charm made of salvaged antenna, said to catch signals from before the crash.

entries.name: Reverse Wallet
entries.desc: A leather wallet that feeds fake IDs to anyone who tries to scan it.

entries.name: Pawnbroker's Scale
entries.desc: A scale that weighs the value of a memory, a favor or an organ, and is never wrong.

entries.name: Glitch Cat
entries.desc: A stray cat with a faintly cybernetic eye. It appears wherever the net drops out.

entries.name: Battery Heart
entries.desc: A portable battery shaped like an organ, favored by those who prefer their power to be warm.

entries.name: Ticket to the Upper Levels
entries.desc: A transit pass that lets its holder ride up one time. The previous owner is not mentioned.

entries.name: Bleach Soda
entries.desc: A neon-blue drink that wipes recent memories. The brand is banned, the bottle is not.

entries.name: Phantom Courier Pager
entries.desc: A pager that rings with jobs from clients who do not exist yet.

entries.name: Canteen of the Last Spring
entries.desc: A dented canteen that always holds a swallow of clean water, from a spring that has long dried up.

entries.name: Scavenger's Atlas
entries.desc: A water-stained road atlas annotated with notes about safe wells, raiders and good tea.

entries.name: The Seed Tin
entries.desc: A sealed tin of heirloom seeds, guarded by generations.

entries.name: Rust Compass
entries.desc: A compass whose needle points toward the nearest working machine.

entries.name: Ration Card No. 17
entries.desc: A faded ration card that is no longer honored, but still carries enormous sentimental value.

entries.name: Lantern of Burnt Oil
entries.desc: A battered oil lamp that has led three caravans through storms. Its glass is smoked black.

entries.name: The Last Battery
entries.desc: A fresh battery wrapped in cloth and traded between families for years.

entries.name: Wind-Up Radio
entries.desc: A hand-cranked radio that picks up a single station reading names of the missing.

entries.name: Gasmask Charm
entries.desc: A cracked mask hung with beads and trinkets, said to ward off bad air and bad luck.

entries.name: Tin Can Phone
entries.desc: A string-and-can pair that somehow carries the voice of whoever is on the other end across the ruins.

entries.name: The Mender's Kit
entries.desc: A roll of needles, wire and patches that can fix clothing, skin and radios alike.

entries.name: Bottle of Clean Air
entries.desc: A sealed jar of pre-collapse air, used in a ceremony at weddings.

entries.name: Scrapwright's Hammer
entries.desc: A rough hammer made from a car axle, used to repair every settlement it passes.

entries.name: Dust Cloak
entries.desc: A sand-colored coat patched from tents and seat covers. It hides its wearer from storms and sentries.

entries.name: Water Divining Rod
entries.desc: A twisted copper rod that bends toward hidden springs and, occasionally, trouble.

entries.name: The Old Map of Roads
entries.desc: A paper map of roads that no longer exist, still used to plan travel by stubborn guides.

entries.name: Chain of Keys
entries.desc: A necklace of keys from locked doors now buried, kept as a memorial.

entries.name: Last Orange
entries.desc: A preserved orange in a jar, a symbol of the old world. It has never been eaten.

entries.name: Caravan Bell
entries.desc: A bell that is rung at dusk when a caravan finds a safe camp. Silence means danger.

entries.name: The Compass Rose Patch
entries.desc: A cloth patch worn by guides, stitched with directions from every journey.

entries.name: Ash Jar
entries.desc: A jar of gray dust collected from a city that burned. Visitors rub it on their hands before entering.

entries.name: The Quiet Crank
entries.desc: A hand-cranked generator that makes no noise and little power.

entries.name: Hubcap Shield
entries.desc: A makeshift shield formed from a car hubcap, cheap and surprisingly sturdy.

entries.name: Dog-Eared Songbook
entries.desc: A battered songbook of old lyrics sung around fires, with margins full of family names.

entries.name: Wire Frog
entries.desc: A twisted wire toy kept by a child through three settlements and one flood.

entries.name: Pump Handle
entries.desc: A single worn pump handle, carried from a destroyed well, said to bring luck to any new settlement.

entries.name: Sandglass of the Wastes
entries.desc: An hourglass filled with desert sand, used by guides to time crossings.

entries.name: Water Purifier Straw
entries.desc: A plastic straw that filters foul water. Its owner guards it with their life.

entries.name: Scribbled Trade Ledger
entries.desc: A water-stained ledger recording every barter in the settlement, still used as law.

entries.name: Matchbox of Seven
entries.desc: A matchbox holding exactly seven matches, carried by a wanderer who refuses to use the last.
